title: Pre-registration amendment - model inputs changed after the freeze; no frozen document was edited
rule: a pre-registration file is frozen before the first bet. Changing a model input must therefore never rewrite one: the frozen files under data/prereg/ are left byte-identical, and this record states what changed, which strategies it touches, and how already-graded settlement is treated.

input_changes.why: the pin is read off the measured home-win rate. The published value came from the 02:13Z standings capture (102/193) whose own caveat said three 11/15 games were still in progress; this session re-read the standings first-hand (102/196 = 0.5204) and the independent finals corpus agrees exactly (102/196). The margin dispersion used to convert the rate into points also moved, 15.96 -> 16.94, because 25 unplayed 0-0 rows had been counted as games.

the 0.15 in engine/parlay.py was a literal the code claimed was measured (the register it read has no top-level rho key); the SGP constants were labelled MODEL-DERIVED. All three are now read from data/derived/parlay_rho.json, which scripts/measure_parlay_rho.py computes from the 196 verified official finals and the official gamebooks, each with n, interval and sample-floor status.

settlement_treatment: games already graded from the sealed ledger (2026-11-14, 2026-11-15) are NOT re-graded: a pick that was published and settled under the frozen inputs stays graded under them, so the amendment cannot move a record. Picks published after this amendment are graded by the same frozen thresholds, which are unchanged; only the line they are measured against moved with the official data it is derived from.
